front: Who are **internal** users of accounting information?
back: Managers and owners who manage, and employees; they use detailed internal reports.

front: External users and their main interests
back: Lenders: repayment. Suppliers: payment on time. Customers: survival. Tax authority: profit and tax. Investors: return. Public: effect on community.

front: What are the four qualitative characteristics?
back: Relevance, reliability, comparability and understandability (plus timeliness in practice).
Information free from material error and bias, and supported by evidence.
Information prepared on a consistent basis so it can be compared between years and with other businesses.
Published: set format, annual, historic, external users. Management: detailed, frequent, flexible, may be forward-looking.
Employees want high pay, owners high profit, banks security: statements must be fair to all.
The current ratio (liquidity): current assets ÷ current liabilities.
Gearing and interest cover: how much is borrowed and whether profit covers interest.
